episode_title: Who decides the future of America?
script_en: Who decides the future of America?.
Millions of Americans have already cast their votes early ahead of Tuesday’s midterms.
On this episode of The Sunday Story , NPR’s senior political correspondent Tamara Keith discusses the turbulent and unpredictable political landscape of this years’ midterm election.
Rising costs and unpopular foreign policy decisions have some experts anticipating a blue wave.
President Trump is predicting the opposite.
But voters on both sides of the aisle share one commonality: they’re not happy.
How will a dissatisfied electorate decide the future of America?
